## Decision

Obsidian vault = .groundwork/ (the tracker dir), with a mudissue-style configurable tracker path so it can live outside the repo. Spec cross-links via a .groundwork/specs -> ../doc/specs symlink; fallback if symlink-following proves unreliable is CLI-emitted relative Markdown links.

## Rationale

Keeping the vault at .groundwork/ requires no repo restructuring and aligns with the existing tracker-dir convention. A symlink for specs enables wikilink navigation from motive notes to requirements without duplicating the doc/specs tree; the relative-link fallback handles Obsidian setups where symlink traversal is unreliable.
